title: Partial backlog implementation sweep (implementation first, verify deferred)
acceptance_criteria: Convert partial backlog items to implementation-complete status by closing guide-leaf gaps in UI/backend.
Keep UI/API workflows form-driven (no free-form CLI primary workflows).
Run validation gates after each completed slice (pytest + tsc/eslint + build + smoke).
Defer live-environment verification to explicit verify phase after implementation backlog closure.
assumptions: Backlog status `verify` is the implementation-complete state for this pass.
Live dual-node or hardware-specific validation remains outside this implementation pass.
